$comment: Acceptance criteria verified by hand or outside the regular CI (12-REQ-03). scripts/check-ac-coverage.mjs counts them as covered.

criteria.how: Manual: a person outside the project installs the package in a fresh Playwright project following the README; timed before 0.1.0 and 1.0.0.
Prototype (WP-02, before the modules were implemented): the results of the assumptions are recorded in the specification repository, not testable here.
Specification repository: export-spec-ids is a script of that repository and is checked there; this repository only consumes spec-ids.json.
Release workflow: provenance attestation is checked on the npm package page after publishing.
Manual: the README installation (create package) is done in a fresh Playwright project and timed; recorded in the release PR.
Manual: the reserved name is checked on npm (npm view) before publishing 0.1.0.
Manual: repository settings (main protection, squash merge only, branch deletion) are reviewed after the repository is created.
